RE: NOTIFICATTION OF EX-IM BANK LOAN APPROVAL – TRANSACTION NO. [TextInput: Transaction Number{"system-name":"transaction-number"}]

We are pleased to inform you that the Export-Import Bank of the United States (“Ex-Im Bank”) has approved our application to finance the purchase by ([Link:borrower-name]) of ([TextInput: Goods Description{"system-name":"goods-description"}]) (the “Goods”) exported from the United Sates by ([TextInput: Exporter Name{"system-name":"exporter-name"}]) to the ([TextInput: Borrower's Country{"system-name":"borrower-country"}]). This financing was applied for in accordance with our mutually signed proposal dated as of ([Date{"system-name":"proposal-date"}]). The financing was officially approved on ([Date{"system-name":"approval-date"}]). The terms and conditions of the final approval may differ in some respect to the original proposal. We request that you please review the section below titled “TERMS OF ATRAFIN’S LOAN AS APPROVED BY EX-IM BANK” in detail. 

The next steps in the process are outlined below:

1. Atrafin will prepare the U.S. governed loan documentation. This will include a credit agreement, promissory note, and supporting documentation. The agreements will reflect the terms and conditions as approved by Ex-Im Bank.
